statCard.name: Red Skull, Master of the World

attacks.name: Cosmic Burst
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!energy| or |!mystic|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Shock|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Reality Bows to Me!
steps: |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |*Reality Rupture|: After this attack is resolved, this character can make an additional |*Reality Bows to Me!| attack without paying the |!power| cost. This additional attack must target a character within |!range| 2 of the original defender that has not been targeted by |*Reality Bows to Me!| this Round.

superPowers.name: My Cabal is Only for the Strong (Affiliation: Cabal)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, after a non-Grunt allied character rolls attack dice but before the |*Resolve Criticals| step, it may treat 1 |!failure| result in the attack roll as a |!critical| result for the remainder of the roll. If it does, after the attack is resolved, the attacking character loses 1 |!power|. If it does not lose |!power|, it suffers 1 |!damage| instead.

superPowers.name: Reshape the World
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 3, and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Nothing is Beyond My Reach
superPowers.body: Choose this character or another character within |!range| 2 of it and Place it within |!range| 3 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Power is Only for the One Who Rules
superPowers.body: When this character spends |!power| to make an attack action or to use a superpower, it may spend |!power| for the attack or superpower from an allied character within |!range| 3 of it.
